'''Headhunter Six''' was the callsign used by one of [[Jessa Vandangante]]'s [[Technician/Legends|mechanics]] when flying with [[Headhunter Flight]] during the [[Battle of the Outlaw Tech Base]], in [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]]. He was a member of the [[Vandangante outlaw techs]], and having no prior combat experience was the third and final casualty in the [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]]. He was the brother of [[Headhunter Five]].<ref name="StarsEnd" />
